nodes.text: Afterwards
Afterwards, Joan is dressing, her naked back visible to John.
Tonight I go to battle. I'd like you to paint me with thoughts that are warm, strong, and fierce.
John brushes her back. He traces a faint line with his fingernail, etching in basic lines.
I can do that.
I don't ask that you do it. I ask that you do it well. All that you do not yet see is apparent to me. You have a gift, you are an artist.
I was never very good at it.
You speak of the past as if it is ancient history. As long as you live and breathe, your will is a vital part of existence. Do not be afraid to exercise your will.
[shot:insert paint]Faust gets up to get his paint. He returns and prepares behind her.
I'm a little afraid but mostly of myself.
That is the best fear. Be your own worst enemy and all others will seem trivial.
How did you get so strong.
I got hurt time after time, my body grew tired of hurting so it became strong.
[shot:insert brush]John strokes her back with his brush.

nodes.caption: Paint me how you see me

nodes.text: Your brush is coarse and scratches.
Would you like me to use one softer?
Paint me how you see me, John Faust and power will come from that.
John kisses her neck, she looks up. The brush comes down her spine.
You will be in my thoughts while I do what I must.
We've only just met. But come back to me in one piece, okay?
What if this is all we get, John Faust?
I'm selfish and don't accept that.
And I repeat, what if this is it?
Wear my ink for as long as you can.
Joan kisses Faust and gets dressed. He touches her dagger until she takes it from him.
Goodbye John Faust.
She is gone. John looks at his brushes. Then gets up to paint.

opts.text: Sit with the brushes a while.

nodes.text: The bristles are still wet with the colors of her back.
He paints Joan charging off into battle. Her clashes, her triumphs, her victory over many strange foe.
A phone ringing interrupts him. Faust answers it.
Yellow?
You and your friends headed by the club tonight?
At some point.
Stop worrying about her and come out and play.
I'm sure she'll be okay.
You don't fool me.
I've only known her a day.
You've known her a lot longer than that.
This is all some test, isn't it?
A worthy quest for a worthy hero.
I'm not, though.
You will be, soon enough.
How bad will things get, if you don't mind me asking?
It's all coming down.
Just as we're building it all up?
Doesn't seem fair, does it?
I'm an optimist. Eternal optimist.
Good. The world needs your kind, too.
Why I'm here.
